source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: God Almighty swears by the horses running in His cause toward the enemy, when the sound of their panting is heard from the speed of their running. It is not permissible for a creature to swear except by God; swearing by other than God is polytheism.
tafsir.muyassar-2: The horses whose hooves strike sparks of fire from their hardness, because of the intensity of their running.
tafsir.muyassar-3: The horses that raid the enemies with their riders at dawn.
tafsir.muyassar-4: They stirred up dust by this running.
tafsir.muyassar-5: They penetrated, with their riders, the midst of the enemy hosts.
tafsir.muyassar-6: Man is truly ungrateful to his Lord's blessings, and he himself bears witness to that ingratitude. And he is truly intense in his love of wealth.
tafsir.muyassar-7: Man is truly ungrateful to his Lord's blessings, and he himself bears witness to that ingratitude. And he is truly intense in his love of wealth.
tafsir.muyassar-8: Man is truly ungrateful to his Lord's blessings, and he himself bears witness to that ingratitude. And he is truly intense in his love of wealth.
tafsir.muyassar-9: Does man not know what awaits him when God raises the dead from the graves for reckoning and recompense?
tafsir.muyassar-10: And what was hidden in the breasts, of good or evil, will be brought out.
tafsir.muyassar-11: Their Lord, on that Day, is fully Aware of them and of their deeds; nothing of that is hidden from Him.
